description: This PHP source file defines the 'HolidayAPI' class within the OrangeHRM leave plugin, providing REST API endpoints for managing holiday records. It includes methods for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting holiday entries, with integrated validation and OpenAPI documentation annotations.

classes.name: HolidayAPI
classes.description: API class for managing holiday resources in the OrangeHRM system, including fetching, creating, updating, and deleting holidays with considerations for validation and documentation.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific holiday by ID, throwing an exception if not found, returning a HolidayModel wrapped in EndpointResourceResult.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Fetches a list of holidays filtered by date range, with support for sorting and pagination, returning an EndpointCollectionResult with holiday data and total count.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new holiday record based on request body parameters, saves it via the holiday service, and returns the created HolidayModel.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing holiday identified by ID with data from request body, then returns the updated HolidayModel.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes holidays by a list of IDs provided in the request body, returning the list of deleted IDs.
